messages:
nina: Quick FYI — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1428 to add batcher helper. CI shows lint failure (import-order + trailing comma) — small stuff but blocking merge.

alex: I can take the import order fix. isort settings changed last month right?

jamie: we tightened isort + black recently. the failing rule is `from x import y` ordering vs stdlib. CI log:
```
E402 module level import not at top of file
ERROR: trailing-comma in call
```

liam: @nina does this PR touch any public API? if not we can do a quick merge once CI is clean.

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests — failure — lint (isort, flake8) — see https://ci.redwood/gh/1428/123

alex: run locally: `pre-commit run isort --files src/batcher/*.py && pre-commit run black --files src/batcher/*.py`

alex: also small suggestion: rename `ctx` -> `context` in helper for clarity — one-liner rename, we'll accept.

nina: ok i'll push a commit fixing import order + rename. should I squash?

jamie: prefer separate commits: lint fix + rename + any refactor. easier to revert.

liam: I can give a quick approval after tests pass.

nina: pushed: `git push origin pr/1428/fix-lint` — command I ran:
```
git checkout pr/1428
applypatch <<'PATCH'
--- a/src/batcher/helper.py
+++ b/src/batcher/helper.py
@@
-from typing import List
-from .utils import compact
+from typing import List
+
+from redwood.utils import compact
@@
-def make_batch(ctx, items, max_size=64,):
+def make_batch(context, items, max_size=64):
     # small helper
     ...
PATCH
```

ci-bot: re-run lint — pending

ci-bot: lint passed

jamie: quick look: import order ok, rename fine. :thumbsup:

liam: approved. go ahead and merge when green.

merge-bot: Merged PR #1428 into main by nina — 1871234599
